label: Flip-flop counts per encoding
subgoals: Take the ceiling of log base two of S for binary and Gray
Use one flip-flop per state for one-hot
Use the ceiling of S over two for Johnson

label: Unused codes
subgoals: Raise two to the number of flip-flops
Subtract the number of used states
Decide whether unused codes are don't-cares or recovered

label: Switching activity of an encoding
subgoals: List the code of each state in the transition order
Count the differing bits of each consecutive pair
Sum the toggles over one pass including the wrap
